edges.label: Side w/ Meredith
edges.condition: Meet Meredith Stout before All Foods, pay with her spiked credchip (or side with Militech), and flirt via text afterward.

edges.label: Trust Hanako
edges.condition: Accept Hanako Arasaka's offer on the Misty rooftop (replayable via 'One More Gig' after credits).

edges.label: Call Panam
edges.condition: Call Panam & ask the Aldecaldos for help on the rooftop (requires completing S59 Queen of the Highway).

edges.label: Let Johnny/Rogue lead
edges.condition: Take the Pseudoendotrizine and let Johnny & Rogue storm Arasaka Tower (requires completing S72 Blistering Love).

edges.label: Secret: Solo
edges.condition: Wait ~5 minutes on the rooftop with Johnny without picking an option; requires specific dialogue choices in S69 Chippin' In at the oil fields ('Nah, fucked that up too', 'What do you want from me?', 'OK. But as second chances go, this is your last.').

edges.label: Suicide
edges.condition: Choose to end it on the rooftop ('Could also just put all this to rest...').

edges.label: Download Blind_n_Dead
edges.condition: When Reed tells you to take control of the vehicle, ignore him three times and choose the dialogue options to keep eavesdropping. Progress until Aurore and Aymeric are eliminated, then *after* selecting the yellow 'Jack In' option, look for the blue option to search and download the Blind_n_Dead file.

edges.label: Side w/ Reed
edges.condition: CRITICAL SPLIT: Help Solomon Reed capture Songbird during Firestarter (permanently locks out PL15 The Killing Moon).

edges.label: Side w/ Songbird
edges.condition: CRITICAL SPLIT: Help Songbird escape during Firestarter (permanently locks out PL11 Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos).
Unlocks after Firestarter regardless of whether you side with Reed or Songbird (Kurt Hansen dies in both paths).
Unlocks after Firestarter regardless of whether you side with Reed or Songbird.
Unlocks after Firestarter (any choice) if you eavesdropped on all 3 dialogues of Hansen's associates in PL09.

edges.label: Loot Behavioral Spec
edges.condition: Loot the Behavioral System Component from the Cerberus unit and either the Erebus or Militech Canto Mk.6 spec in Cynosure.

edges.label: Kill Songbird
edges.condition: CRITICAL SPLIT: Grant Songbird's final request and unplug her in Cynosure (locks out PLE02 & PL18 The Tower ending).

edges.label: Spare Songbird
edges.condition: CRITICAL SPLIT: Refuse Songbird's request and hand her over alive to Solomon Reed (unlocks PL14 & PL18 The Tower ending).

edges.label: Hand to Reed
edges.condition: CRITICAL SPLIT: Call Reed and hand Songbird over to the FIA at the spaceport (unlocks PL16 & PL18 The Tower ending).

edges.label: Send to Moon
edges.condition: CRITICAL SPLIT: Confront/kill Solomon Reed and put Songbird on the shuttle to the Moon (unlocks PL17 & PL19).

edges.label: Body to Family/Vik
edges.condition: Tell Delamain to send Jackie's body to his family (or Viktor, though only Mama Welles unlocks the full Ofrenda & rewards).

edges.label: Support Us Cracks

edges.label: Spare Rinder
edges.condition: Spare Leon Rinder in exchange for his stash coordinates during Gig: The Man Who Killed Jason Foreman.

edges.condition: Call Mr. Hands and convince him to let Hasan go during Gig: Prototype in the Scraper.
